DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち物についてのお問い合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your inquiry about something you are carrying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事で使う工具を買いました。車に載せて現場へ持って行く前に、持ち運ぶ時の扱いを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事工具を車で運ぶ前に扱いの相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought tools for work. Before loading them into my car to take to the worksite, I would like advice on how to handle them during transport.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want advice on handling work tools before transporting them by car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような物で、どのようにお使いになるかを伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will ask what the items are and how you will use them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 作業用の刃物も含まれています。まだ店の包装のままで、使う場所は会社の現場です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 刃物を含む未開封購入品と会社現場での用途を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They include cutting tools for work. They are still in the shop's packaging, and I will use them at my company's worksite.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the unopened purchases include cutting tools and are intended for use at your company's worksite. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご事情と現物について、担当が確認します。こちらで一律に問題ないとは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible staff member will check your circumstances and the actual items. We cannot give a blanket judgment here that there is no issue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。仕事用だと言えばいつでも車に置けると思わず、現場へ運ぶ用件を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事用なら常時積載可と思わず運搬用件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not assume that saying they are for work means I can leave them in the car at all times. I will explain why I need to transport them to the worksite.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your reason for transporting them without assuming work tools can always be kept in the car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会社の担当にも、運ぶ方法や管理をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check transport methods and storage with the person in charge at your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 工具を置いたまま休日も乗る予定でしたが、まず扱いを聞きます。会社の注文票も持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休日にも積載予定だったことと注文票所持を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I had planned to drive on my days off with the tools still in the car, but I will first ask how to handle them. I also have my company's order form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you had planned to leave them in the car on days off, and have the order form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 注文票と、今後の使い方を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show the staff member the order form and explain how you intend to use them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作業する場所と日、買った工具を伝えます。相談する間に包装を開けず、担当の説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 使用場所日と現物を未開封で担当へ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain the place and date of the work and which tools I bought. I would like to keep the packaging closed during the consultation and listen to the staff member's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the place and date of use and the actual items to the staff member, keeping them unopened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you to the staff member, then. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 印刷のご注文についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss your printing order?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 年賀はがきを百二十枚頼みましたが、家族の分が増えて三十枚追加したいです。まだ枚数を変えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 百二十枚注文後に同絵柄を三十枚追加できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I ordered 120 New Year's postcards, but my family needs more, so I would like to add 30. Can I still change the quantity?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can add 30 with the same design after ordering 120. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文の進み具合を担当へ確認します。注文の控えをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask the staff member how far the order has progressed. Do you have your order receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。最初の百二十枚を取り消したいのではなく、同じ絵柄を三十枚増やしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えを示し元注文の取消でなく追加と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I do not want to cancel the original 120; I want to add 30 with the same design.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your receipt and explain that this is an addition, not cancellation of the original order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 印刷が始まっているかによって追加方法が変わります。文面も同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: How we add them depends on whether printing has started. Is the wording the same, too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 文面は同じです。家族から宛先の一覧が増えたと聞いたので、印刷する側の住所や名前は変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 文面住所氏名は変更せず送り先一覧が増えたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The wording is the same. My family told me the recipient list had grown, so I will not change the address or names printed on the cards.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the wording, printed address and names remain unchanged and the recipient list has grown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加分の料金と受取日は、担当がご案内します。いつまでに必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain the additional charge and pickup date. When do you need them by?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週の金曜までに欲しいです。初めの注文の受取日が、そのまま追加分にも使えるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来週金曜希望で追加分の受取日を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like them by next Friday. I want to check whether the original order's pickup date can also apply to the additional cards.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want them by next Friday and ask them to confirm the pickup date for the additions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を伝えます。いま追加の受付が済んだということではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on your request. This does not mean the addition has already been accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。合計で百五十枚欲しいと伝え、追加の方法と金曜までに受け取れるかの返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合計百五十枚の希望をまとめ追加方法料金受取日の確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will explain that I want 150 in total and wait for an answer about how to add them and whether I can collect them by Friday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize your request for 150 in total and wait for confirmation of the addition method, charge and pickup date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、控えで担当に確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with the staff member using your receipt. Thank you for consulting us. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座のご利用について、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble using your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 古い携帯なので、銀行のアプリを新しくできません。残高を確認する方法をほかに知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 古い端末でアプリ更新できず残高確認の別方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My phone is old, so I cannot update the bank's app. I would like to know another way to check my balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your old device cannot update the app and ask another way to check the balance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: アプリの利用条件は確認が必要です。今日は端末の買替え以外の方法をお探しですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the app's requirements. Today you are looking for an option other than replacing your device, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。すぐには買い替えられません。友人の携帯に自分の口座を入れるのも避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: すぐ買替えず友人端末へ口座登録しない希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I cannot replace it immediately. I also want to avoid registering my account on a friend's phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not replace it immediately and do not want to register your account on a friend's device. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の口座について、窓口などで確認できる方法を担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will explain ways to check your own account, such as at a counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。通帳とカードは家にあります。必要な物を聞いて、次に持って来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家の通帳カードを次回持参するため必要物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. My passbook and card are at home. I would like to ask what I need and bring those things next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what you need so you can bring the passbook and card from home next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 方法によって確認に必要な物が違うので、担当へご用件を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The items needed for verification differ by method, so please explain your purpose to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入金があったか知りたいだけです。振込や新しい口座を頼む予定はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用件は入金確認のみと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only want to know whether a payment has come in. I do not plan to request a transfer or a new account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your only purpose is to check an incoming payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご用件も担当へお伝えします。携帯の暗証番号をこちらへ伝える必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that purpose on to the staff member, too. You do not need to tell us your phone's passcode.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 暗証番号は言わず、アプリが使えないことと入金確認の希望を説明します。必要な持ち物をメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 暗証番号を伝えず状況と持ち物案内をメモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I cannot use the app and want to check an incoming payment without giving my passcode. I would like to make a note of what I need to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Without giving your passcode, explain your situation and note the guidance on what to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当窓口へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you to the appropriate counter, then. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの食品を、回収箱へ入れるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to put the food you brought into the collection box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家にある未開封の食品を寄付したいです。ただ、日本語の表示がないので、受け付けるか先に聞きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参未開封食品の日本語表示なしを投入前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to donate unopened food from home. But it has no Japanese labeling, so I asked first whether you accept it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before placing it in the box, ask about the unopened food you brought that has no Japanese labeling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この回収では、内容を日本語の表示で確認できる食品をお願いしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this collection, we ask for foods whose contents can be checked through Japanese labeling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら、封が開いていなくても今回は入れられないのですね。自分で訳した紙を貼ればよいかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封でも対象外と理解し自己訳貼付案を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I cannot put it in this time even though it is unopened. I thought perhaps I could attach a paper with my own translation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that even unopened food is ineligible and ask about attaching your own translation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の訳を貼った物を、この受付の表示の代わりにはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: An item with your own translation attached cannot substitute for the labeling required by this collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、この食品は持ち帰ります。次に持ってくる物を選べるよう、回収の案内をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象外の食品を持ち帰り次回選定用の回収案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will take this food home. Could I have the collection guidelines so I can choose what to bring next time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will take the ineligible food home and ask for collection guidelines to help choose items next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの食品はお持ち帰りください。回収の案内はお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please take this food home. We can give you the collection guidelines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家には日本語の表示がある缶詰もあります。期限の条件などは、この案内で確かめればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日本語表示のある缶詰の期限などを案内で確認できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I also have canned food with Japanese labeling at home. Can I check the expiry-date requirements and so on in these guidelines?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the guidelines explain expiry requirements and other conditions for canned food with Japanese labeling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。対象となる食品と期限などの条件をこちらにまとめています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. This summarizes eligible foods and requirements such as expiry dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で缶詰の表示と見比べます。合う物がなければ、今回は無理に寄付せず、別の機会にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 缶詰と条件を照合し対象がなければ寄付を見送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will compare them with the labels on my canned food at home. If nothing meets the conditions, I will not force a donation this time and will wait for another opportunity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the canned food with the conditions and forgo donating if nothing is eligible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、食品をお持ちになってお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please take your food with you and have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体操会のご参加についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about participating in the exercise gathering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母と参加したいです。母は長い時間立てないので、途中で座れるか主催者に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長く立てない母と体操会参加を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take part with my mother. She cannot stand for a long time, so I would like to ask the organizer whether she can sit down partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss participating in the exercise gathering with your mother, who cannot stand for long. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。椅子での参加をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the staff member. Would she like to participate using a chair?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。家から椅子を持つことも考えていますが、使ってよい場所を先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持込椅子の可否と設置場所を先に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I am considering bringing a chair from home, but I want to know first where we would be allowed to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask first whether you may bring a chair and where it can be placed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持込や配置については、主催者の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please follow the organizer's guidance on bringing chairs and their placement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。通路の好きな所へ置かず、案内された場所で使います。全部の動きをする必要もあるのか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路へ自己設置せず動作の参加範囲も相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. We will not put it anywhere we like in the walkway; we will use it in the designated place. I also want to ask whether she has to do every movement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not place it in the walkway on your own and ask about the extent of participation in the movements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 運動への参加方法は、主催者とご本人の体調に合わせて相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please discuss how to participate in the exercise with the organizer, taking her physical condition into account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 母が休みたいと言ったら、周りに合わせて続けさせないようにします。私は隣で付き添います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 母の休み希望を尊重し隣で付き添うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If my mother says she wants to rest, I will not make her keep going just to match everyone else. I will stay beside her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will respect your mother's wish to rest and stay beside her. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を主催者へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass those wishes on to the organizer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。椅子の場所と途中で休むことを確認してから、母に参加できそうか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配置と休憩条件確認後本人へ参加を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. After checking the chair location and taking breaks partway through, I will discuss with my mother whether she feels able to participate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After confirming placement and break arrangements, discuss participation with her. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へおつなぎします。よい一日をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the staff member, then. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方と、同じ列車にお乗りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you and your companion taking the same train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別々です。私は先の列車、友人は後の列車に乗ります。私が出るまで、二人で待てる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別時刻出発前に二人で待てる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Different trains. I am taking an earlier train and my friend a later one. Is there somewhere we can wait together until I leave?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a place where both of you can wait before your departures at different times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札外の待合をご利用いただけます。乗る列車の時刻はそれぞれ確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use the waiting area outside the ticket gates. Have you each checked your train's departure time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は十五時、友人は十五時半です。私が先に出た後も、友人はこちらで待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各出発時刻を伝え本人出発後も友人が待合を使えるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mine is at 3 p.m. and my friend's at 3:30 p.m. Can my friend keep waiting here after I leave first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give both departure times and confirm whether your friend can use the waiting area after you leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、後の列車までこちらで待てます。ご自身の出発が近くなりましたら、先にホームへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, your friend can wait here until the later train. When your departure approaches, please head to the platform first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。私が先に改札を通ります。切符はそれぞれ自分で持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先に単独通過し友人券は本人所持と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I will go through the ticket gate first. We each have our own ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will pass through alone first and your friend has their own ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お荷物も、お一人ずつお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also each have your own luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 買った物を一つの袋に入れていました。待合で自分の分を分け、友人の物を持っていかないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 混ぜた買物を本人別に分けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We put our purchases in one bag. I will separate my things in the waiting area so I do not take my friend's things with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will separate the combined purchases by owner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋を整理する時は、席や通路を広く占めないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When sorting the bag, please avoid taking up too much space on seats or in the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人の足元で分けます。出発前に互いの袋を確認し、ここで別れてから私はホームへ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 占有せず袋照合後に別れて向かうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will sort them at our feet. Before leaving, we will check each other's bags, say goodbye here, and then I will head to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid occupying extra space, check the bags and part before heading off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、それぞれの列車へ余裕を持ってどうぞ。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please allow plenty of time for your respective trains. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 清掃行事のお申し込みですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are applying for the cleanup event, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 参加したいですが、長時間しゃがむのは難しいです。座ったままでできる手伝いもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 座位で可能な行事参加を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to participate, but squatting for a long time is difficult. Are there tasks I can help with while seated?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about participating in the event in a seated position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は受付で相談事項をお預かりします。主催担当へ確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today we are taking requests for consultation at reception. I will check with the organizer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋を配ったり、終わった道具を数えたりならできます。場所の希望より、姿勢について相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋配布や道具確認を例に姿勢の配慮を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can distribute bags or count the tools after use. Rather than a preference for a location, I would like to discuss my working posture.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give distributing bags and checking tools as examples and ask for consideration of your posture. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その二つの例を、担当へ伝えてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: May I pass those two examples on to the staff member?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。ただ、必ずその仕事にしてほしいということではありません。できる役割を一緒に考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 特定役割を強制せず相談希望と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. But I am not asking to be assigned those jobs for certain. I would like to think together about a role I can do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are requesting consultation rather than insisting on a specific role. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申込書の連絡欄にも、相談希望と記していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you also write in the contact section of the application that you would like to consult us?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「長くしゃがむ作業は難しいため、役割を相談したい」と書きました。理由の詳しい説明は担当へ直接します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配慮相談を記し詳細は担当へ直接話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote, 'I would like to discuss my role because work involving prolonged squatting is difficult.' I will explain the detailed reasons directly to the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write your request for consideration and say you will explain the details directly to the staff member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当からお電話する連絡先を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will confirm the contact number for the staff member to call you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯の番号はここです。平日の夕方なら話しやすいので、その時間も添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夕方の携帯連絡を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: My mobile number is here. Weekday evenings are easier for me to talk, so please add that time as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request contact on your mobile in the evening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を添えて担当へ渡します。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will include your wishes and pass this to the staff member. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の容器をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have your sample container?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。採尿はできましたが、ふたが斜めになって閉まりません。このまま運ぶ前に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採尿後ふたが斜めで閉まらず運搬前確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I was able to collect the urine sample, but the lid is crooked and will not close. I would like you to look before I carry it like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: After collecting urine, explain that the lid is crooked and will not close, and ask for a check before transport. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いったんこちらの台へ置いてください。無理に閉めようとせず、そのまま確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please put it on this counter for now. We will check it as it is without trying to force it closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 台へ置きました。ふたを強く押し込んで容器を倒しそうだったので、それ以上は触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 台に置き強押しをやめそれ以上触らないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put it on the counter. I nearly knocked the container over while pushing the lid down hard, so I have not touched it any further.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you put it on the counter, stopped pushing hard and have not touched it further. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかの容器へ移したり、何かを加えたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you transferred it to another container or added anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。渡されたこの容器のままです。漏れているかは、まだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移替や追加なしで漏れ未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have done neither. It is still in this container you gave me. I do not yet know whether it is leaking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have neither transferred it nor added anything, and have not confirmed whether it is leaking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容器と周囲はこちらで確認します。ご本人のお名前のラベルも確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the container and the surrounding area. Please also let us check the label with your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ラベルはこちらです。この名前で合っています。容器のことを確認していただいている間、どこで待てばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人ラベルの氏名を確認し容器確認中の待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The label is here. This name is correct. Where should I wait while you check the container?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your name on the label and ask where to wait while the container is checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの椅子でお待ちください。容器の扱いと、検査を進めるかは担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait in this chair. We will check with the staff member about handling the container and whether to proceed with the test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。容器を替えるか、もう一度採るかは自分で決めず、担当の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 検査続行未確定と理解し容器交換再採取を自己判断せず待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will not decide for myself whether to change the container or collect another sample; I will wait for the staff member's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand that proceeding with the test is not yet decided and wait without deciding on replacement or recollection yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで引き継ぎます。お知らせありがとうございました。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take over here. Thank you for letting us know. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss your bicycle, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車は駐輪場にあります。なくしたのは鍵だけで、自転車を盗まれたという相談ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車でなく鍵の紛失と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My bicycle is in the bicycle parking area. I lost only the key; I am not reporting that the bicycle was stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the loss of the key from the loss of the bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鍵は、どのような物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What does the key look like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さな銀色の鍵に、緑の丸い飾りが付いています。家の鍵とは別に持っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 銀色鍵と緑丸飾りを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a small silver key with a round green ornament. I carried it separately from my house key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the silver key and round green ornament. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に使った場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where you last used it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日、駅の駐輪場で施錠しました。その後はポケットに入れたつもりですが、出した記憶はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅駐輪場での最後の使用を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday I locked the bicycle at the station's bicycle parking area. I thought I put it in my pocket afterward, but I do not remember taking it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you last used it at the station's bicycle parking area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 遺失物の担当へ、鍵の特徴と最後に使った場所を伝えます。自転車は今もそこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the lost-property staff what the key looks like and where you last used it. Is the bicycle still there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。昨日置いた場所に、鍵が掛かったままあります。なくなったのは鍵だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自転車は駐輪場に施錠状態で残り鍵だけがないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. It is still locked in the place where I left it yesterday. Only the key is missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the bicycle remains locked in the parking area and only the key is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: スペアの鍵はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have a spare key?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋に一つあります。今日は届け出をした後に取りに戻り、自分の鍵で自転車を回収するつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: スペアを自宅から持ち回収する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: There is one in my room. Today, after filing the report, I plan to go back for it and collect the bicycle using my own key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you plan to bring the spare from home and collect the bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 鍵の特徴を記録します。自転車の状況は区別して伺いました。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will record the key's features. I have noted the bicycle's situation separately. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお出しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。宛先だけ書いて、裏に自分の住所と名前を書き忘れました。今、書き足したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 差出人住所氏名の書忘れを申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote only the destination and forgot to put my own address and name on the back. I would like to add them now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you forgot the sender's address and name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お預かりする前に、お書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please write them before we accept it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 作業台を使います。相手の住所をもう一度書くのではなく、差出人として自分の住所ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 裏面へ本人住所を書き足すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will use the worktable. I should write my own address as the sender, rather than writing the other person's address again, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will add your own address on the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ご自身の住所とお名前をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please write your own address and name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 部屋番号も入れました。建物名が長いので、住所の続きとして次の行に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号と長い建物名を記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I included my room number. The building name is long, so I will put it on the next line as a continuation of the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write the room number and long building name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書けましたら、宛先の面と区別できるかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: When finished, please check that it can be distinguished from the destination side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表には相手の名前、裏には私の名前です。同じ姓ですが、住所で区別できるよう書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同姓の宛先と差出人を住所で区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The other person's name is on the front and my name is on the back. We have the same surname, but I wrote the addresses so they can be distinguished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the recipient and sender with the same surname by their addresses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この封筒の中身について、送付方法の確認をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the shipping method based on the contents of this envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙の手紙だけです。差出人を書き終えたので、この一通をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙手紙一通の受付を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It contains only a paper letter. I have finished writing the sender, so please accept this one letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask them to accept one paper letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認してお預かりします。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check and accept it. Goodbye.
